pick.headline: Yeltsin inaugurated as first elected president of Russia
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of July 10, 1991, carried a Moscow TASS preview of the Russian congress session at which Yeltsin, Russia's first-ever president, would be sworn in with Gorbachev due to speak, and a television item on Yeltsin as "nervous" on the eve of inauguration.

alternates.headline: Army coup topples Mauritania's President Ould Daddah
alternates.fbis: The Middle East & North Africa Daily Report of July 10, 1978, carried a Paris AFP report that a military Committee of National Recovery had seized power in Mauritania overnight in an apparently bloodless coup, dissolving the constitution and ruling party, with President Ould Daddah believed arrested.
